scores.rationale: Explicitly distinguishes retaining portfolio cash from investing more in bonds, conditioning the latter on sufficient separate reserves. Generic cap of 6 applied.

scores.evidence_span: The emergency reserve should generally be established before making irreversible mortgage prepayments.
